title: Three-query circuit PCPP description
statement: For a Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input bits, with $n>0$, the quadratic circuit construction assigns a PCPP description for the property that the circuit accepts its input. The description has three queries and satisfies the perfect-completeness and rejection-rate conditions of a PCPP for that property.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits
caveat: The defining construction refers to an upstream four-query PCPP description and a three-query conversion whose definitions are not included in the payload.
